headlines.text: Turning the clock back to 2025: Kyle Fletcher vs. Daniel Garcia met in a Number One Contender, closing out the card as the main event on Collision, rated 7.88 ? a match that delivered.
Turning the clock back to 2023: it was The Butcher & Menard's first night in AEW as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.29.
Rewind to 2024, when Mariah May vs. Hikaru Shida met in an Owen Hart Tournament Match, serving as the night's main event on Rampage, rated 6.71 ? part of that year's Beach Break '24 - Night 2.

secondaries.text: On this day in 2023, it was a welcome sight as Gurv Sihra returned to the ring after just under 4 months away, appearing on Dynamite.
Looking back to 2023, when Kenny Omega vs. Wheeler Yuta headlined Dynamite, rated 7.78 ? a well-worked match.
